bugcourier.screen.title: Report a bug
bugcourier.screen.issue_title.hint: Short title, like "Far mountains flicker when zooming"
bugcourier.screen.description.hint: What did you do, what did you expect, and what happened instead?
bugcourier.screen.need_more: Write at least %s characters about what happened
bugcourier.screen.no_mods: None of your mods list an issue tracker yet.
bugcourier.preview.title: This is exactly what will be sent
bugcourier.preview.how: Opens %s in your browser with the report filled in. You review it there and press Submit.
bugcourier.preview.how_paste: Opens %s in your browser. The report is copied, so paste it there.
bugcourier.sent.title: Almost done
bugcourier.sent.body: %s is open in your browser with the report filled in. The full logs are in %s: drag that file into the issue, or paste the report from your clipboard. Then press Submit.
bugcourier.sent.body_nozip: %s is open in your browser with the report filled in. The full report is on your clipboard: paste it into the issue, then press Submit.
bugcourier.crash.title: The game crashed last time
bugcourier.crash.body: Want to send the crash report to the mod that caused it? You'll see everything before it's sent.
